question: Find the display name of the user who owns the most popular post (by view count) among those who have posted at least one comment containing a URL and also hold both 'Teacher' and 'Supporter' badges.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
  SELECT c.XCL_010 FROM comments c WHERE c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%'
)
AND u.XCL_052 IN (
  SELECT b.XCL_002 FROM badges b WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
)
AND u.XCL_052 IN (
  SELECT b.XCL_002 FROM badges b WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Supporter'
)
ORDER BY p.XCL_030 DESC
LIMIT 1
